goal_source: Owner decision, 2026-11-24: public history is not rewritten to remove an author email. That would need a force push to main. The goal stays 0, so each miss stays visible. anthropic.com is not counted: it is the tool address Claude Code cloud sessions commit as. One address at another organization's domain stays a miss, an accepted exception (project decision, 2026-11-25). The domain is a private term and cannot be listed in this public repo, so it cannot go in org_domains. Template source: GitHub Docs, Setting your commit email address (read 2026-11-19).
